rules: only C frozen budget-selected category rules; union across configs/budgets for inference; no re-mining
content_difference: directed-rule and unordered-combination Jaccard; new-rule share relative to G at same original system budget; report effective unique counts; also flag absence from G top100
global_absence_limit: absence from Top-B or Top100 is not absence from all Global eligible/discovered rules; complete eligible pool not used

main_contrasts.lift_diagnostics: target/global and target/rest lift ratios; descriptive, undefined denominator remains missing
main_contrasts.strict_specificity: minimum target-minus-other confidence difference, plus minimum association difference; compare each other group separately

discovery_advantage_candidate: target passes common point/count/concentration gates (no Discovery significance claim); rest antecedent orders>=20 from >=10 customers; target-rest confidence gap>=5pp and association gap>0
validation_supported_advantage: same common target point/count gates; rest opportunity; confidence gap>=5pp; association gap>0; new one-vs-rest combined BY q<=0.05
strict_all_others: also requires >=5pp confidence gap and positive association gap versus each other group, adequate antecedent opportunity in each, and strict combined BY q<=0.05

inference.variance: customer-cluster delta method; disjoint target/rest variances added; t df=min(customer_counts)-1; conservative treatment of degenerate SE
inference.combined_one_vs_rest_p: max(target quality association/increment p, confidence-gap p, association-gap p)
inference.combined_strict_p: max(one-vs-rest p, all pairwise confidence-gap and association-gap p)
inference.family: one system (control,method,seed); all unique (group,rule_id) across five configs and three budgets; one-vs-rest and strict hypotheses corrected together using BY; BH sensitivity also reported
inference.period: BY acceptance on Validation only; Discovery used to define fixed descriptive advantage candidates
inference.limits: pointwise approximate CIs; system-wise nominal correction, not all-system global inference; random upper tails descriptive

retention.denominator: all frozen Discovery advantage candidates, including future untriggered/insufficient candidates
retention.direction: future confidence gap>0 and future association gap>0
retention.effect_retention_ratio: Validation confidence gap / Discovery confidence gap only when Discovery gap>=5pp
retention.survival: Discovery candidate AND Validation supported advantage

complementarity: full co-occurrence and antecedent-only uniqueness kept distinct; report local-only, global-only, net and union; no precision/recall/F1 claim
hybrid: reuse existing G50+L50 deduplicated matched-K experiment; no remine or new budget fitting
